<noinclude>
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Blockquote
History: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Blockquote&action=history
Revision: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Blockquote&oldid=1317335651 (10/17/2025 4:04 PM UTC)
Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten with phpBB's quote BBCode instead of the Lua module (Module:Quotation), <blockquote> and TemplateStyles the wiki does not have; the author, title and source follow the text after a dash, inside the quote; no character, multiline, style or class options; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Blockquote|Wikis are fun.}}
Example: {{Blockquote|Wikis are fun.|A. Writer|My Book|1999}}
Example: {{Blockquote|text=Short.|author=Someone}}
